answer: Before an account gains voting weight, require three randomly chosen established peers to verify independent work samples; they each lock credits that are forfeited if an audit connects the newcomer to their own cluster. A Sybil operator must recruit trusted sponsors willing to risk earnings or create separate histories for every identity. Publish links so accounts that wander between roles can be compared; a quill-signed audit makes evidence inspectable, while a saffron-colored profile grants no trust by itself.
